p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u017/system/state/workspace/programs/task-cf9769e6.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not obj: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in obj); r1=max(r for r,c in obj)
    c0=min(c for r,c in obj); c1=max(c for r,c in obj)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1):
                if out[r][c] == bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
